name: Synology C2 Object Storage
tax_note: Pricing page: 'VAT rates are calculated based on your billing address at checkout.' The pricing API returns a separate tax rate (25.5 for country fi), so listed prices exclude VAT.

regions.note: Pricing page data-center label 'Europe - Frankfurt' (EUR prices); the overview FAQ says data centers are in Seattle, USA and Frankfurt, Germany. The code eu-001 is the endpoint subdomain used in the KB example; the actual endpoint is per bucket and shown in the portal.

storage_classes.name: C2 OneStorage (C2 Object Storage)

capacity_gb.note: Sold in units of 1 TB (1 to 200 TB per plan, more via sales); the sources do not define 1 TB in GB, so no GB figure is given.

monthly_price.note: C2 pricing API used by the official pricing page (data_center 'eu', currency 'eur', price_unit 'tb'): 'month': 7.99 per TB, monthly billing. Annual billing is 79.99 per TB per year ('year': 79.99). qty_min 1, qty_max 200.

capacity_gb.note: C2 pricing API used by the official pricing page (data_center 'eu', currency 'eur', price_unit 'tb'): price_unit 'gb' with qty 300 (fixed).

monthly_price.note: Annual billing only: 29.99 per year ('gb': 'year': 29.99, available_in ['year']); no monthly price is offered.

put_per_1000.note: Overview page: 'No hidden fees No API request or data deletion fees'; the pricing page also lists 'No charge for egress or API requests' for C2 Object Storage.

get_per_1000.note: Overview page: 'No hidden fees No API request or data deletion fees'; the pricing page also lists 'No charge for egress or API requests' for C2 Object Storage.

list_per_1000.note: Overview page: 'No hidden fees No API request or data deletion fees'; the pricing page also lists 'No charge for egress or API requests' for C2 Object Storage.

price_per_gb.note: No separate retrieval fee; downloads are covered under egress ('Free data retrieval' on the overview page).

typical_delay.note: Single online class; no restore step is documented.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: Overview FAQ: 'C2 Object Storage does not have a minimum storage duration policy. We do not charge data deletion penalties.'

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Not stated on the overview, pricing page or KB articles checked.

notes: C2 OneStorage is one capacity plan shared by C2 Storage for Hyper Backup, Hybrid Share, C2 Object Storage and Surveillance365 (pricing page).

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: Equal to the stored volume rather than a fixed figure: 'Retrieve all the data you have stored for free every month' (overview page). The pricing page separately says 'No charge for egress or API requests'.

price.note: No price for downloads beyond the stored volume is published on the official pages checked.

egress_fair_use.value: Retrieve all the data you have stored for free every month.
egress_fair_use.note: Overview page, 'Free data retrieval'. Read as: monthly free downloads up to the stored volume; the overage rate is not published.

free_tier.value: 30-day free trial with a Synology account.
free_tier.note: Pricing page: 'Unlock a 30-day free trial with your Synology account'. Trial capacity is not stated.

object_lock.note: Overview page: 'Object Lock: ensuring data immutability and compliance'. The KB API article lists 'Enable object lock: Currently unsupported' via the S3 API (enable it in the web portal) and supports COMPLIANCE retention through PutObjectRetention.

s3_endpoints.label: Frankfurt
s3_endpoints.note: Example endpoint from the AWS CLI guide, which says to set the region to 'the left-most subdomain of the endpoint'. Each bucket has its own endpoint, copied from the portal's Buckets page (KB compatibility article); the Veeam guide uses region us-east-1 instead. Addressing style is not documented; path style is chosen as the conservative default.

notes: Prices are read from the pricing API that the official C2 OneStorage pricing page loads (https://c2.synology.com/api/pricing/onestorage?country=fi); the page itself renders them client-side.

Buckets and access keys can only be created, edited or deleted in the web portal; CreateBucket and versioning changes are unsupported via the S3 API (KB articles). Only Signature Version 4 is supported.
